page.overview:
Who is Lilac Links?

Lilac Links is a female Earth pony who appears in Winter Wrap Up, The Show Stoppers, and . She has a purple coat, pale blue mane, cerise eyes, and a cutie mark of two linked horseshoes.__TOC__

Lilac Links is identical to Shoeshine in all but eye style and coat color, Sunny Smiles in all but eye style and coat and mane colors, Grape Delight in all but eyes and cutie mark, and Luckette in all but eyes and mane and cutie mark colors, and she shares her design with Sweetie Drops, "Blue Bows", "Spring Water", "Tree Sap", "Vanilla Sweets", "Apricot Bow", S04E22 Unnamed Earth Mare #8, and S04E24 Unnamed Earth Mare #3 and her eye color and cutie mark with Eclair Crème.

In Winter Wrap Up, Lilac Links appears twice during the titular song singing in the chorus. Here, her coat color is lighter than usual. In The Show Stoppers, Lilac Links appears briefly walking toward Carousel Boutique when the Cutie Mark Crusaders try to get their cutie marks in mane-styling.

In , Lilac Links appears on pages 1, 2, and 22 speaking with Rarity. Here, she has lines of dialogue, and she is addressed by name.
